bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

abilities.text: The Doomsday Blaster can only be fired in High Power mode if the Canoptek Stalker has not moved this Turn.

abilities.name: Sentinel Construct
abilities.text: Once per Round when any enemy moves within range of a Canoptek Doomstalker’s Twin Gauss Flayer it can fire the Twin Gauss Flayer.

abilities.name: Explosive
abilities.text: When a Canoptek Doomstalker is destroyed, roll 1d6. If you roll a Complication or an Exalted Icon, the Canoptek Doomstalker explodes with the following profile: 16 +4 ED / Blast (10)
